lines: Developers struggle to map reality with a swarm intelligence mirror.
MiroFish uses multi-agent technology to make predictions about public opinion events like university trends.
It runs a simulation engine powered by OASIS to generate reports on trending events.
Try Dream of the Red Chamber Lost Ending Simulation to see deep prediction of the lost ending.
You can run a simulation on trending public opinion events.
You can run it with Node.js, Python and uv tools on your machine.
MiroFish is supported by Shanda Group and uses OASIS for its simulation engine.
First copy the example environment file, then edit your local dot env to add needed keys.
Save this for a deep prediction simulation on public opinion events.
Try the universal swarm intelligence engine named MiroFish.
